direction.camera: Guide attention with line drawing; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: one line diagram explains a single product relationship; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with diagram logic; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with gentle reveal.
direction.lighting: clean white fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: technical pen and white stock; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around readable annotation; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use line drawing,diagram logic,sparse color,stepwise proof,readable annotation,gentle reveal as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
